description: This file defines a Smarty plugin function named html_checkboxes that generates a list of checkbox inputs based on given parameters. It processes parameters to customize the checkboxes, including their names, values, options, checked states, separators, and output customization. The function also handles output escaping and optional assignment of the generated HTML to a Smarty variable.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_checkboxes
methods.description: Main function that processes input parameters and generates the HTML for checkboxes.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_checkboxes_output
methods.description: Helper function that creates individual checkbox HTML elements based on parameters.
